title: Fix guard evaluation, hook ordering, and exception rollback in StateMachine
prompt:
Fix the bugs in `fsm/machine.py`:
1. Transition guards (`guard(ctx) -> bool`) must be checked before leaving the current state; if `False`, raise `PermissionError` without changing state or firing `on_exit`.
2. Hook order on a valid transition `A -> B`: `guard` -> `on_exit(A)` -> update state to `B` -> `on_enter(B)`.
3. If `on_enter(B)` raises an exception, roll `machine.state` back to `A` before re-raising.
Run `pytest` to verify.
